recommendation_rule: Keep configurations within 5 percentage points of the highest overall correctness. Within that group, keep configurations within 5 percentage points of the highest fraction of all tasks answered correctly within 5 seconds. Recommend the lowest billed cost per correct result within 5 seconds. Show the full accuracy, latency, and cost table and the tradeoffs; this is a declared preference rule, not a universal winner.
cost_uncertainty: Do not turn missing cost into zero. Show reported spend and conservative reserved-cost bounds; a recommendation with unknown charges is provisional.
uncertainty: Bootstrap 5000 samples of the 60 questions, retaining all five repetitions of each sampled question. Report 95% intervals; screening and pilot requests are excluded from final accuracy and latency.
latency_population: SQL-ready quantiles cover completed SQL responses. Result-ready quantiles cover successful database executions, including wrong answers. Also report latency for correct answers. Failures stay in the denominator of correctness and deadline success.
